div.p: The official URL for this implementation guide is:

The Nigeria Core Implementation Guide defines the minimum set of FHIR RESTful interactions for each of the Nigeria Core Profiles to access patient data. The Profiles are updated monthly to support the latest requirements from The Nigeria Digital in Health Initiative under Sector Wide Approach (SWaP) for Health Information in Nigeria.

description.value: Fictional contact-investigation response with three household contacts and different screening outcomes.

One model instance represents a laboratory register and contains repeatable laboratory entries corresponding to individual patient/specimen rows in the source register.

name.value: NG TB Patient Referral/Transfer QuestionnaireResponse Example

name.value: NG TB Patient Treatment Card QuestionnaireResponse Example

description.value: Fictional longitudinal TB treatment-card response with diagnostic results, treatment monitoring, adherence records and outcome.
